reason: The zero-transport v24 replay resolved 119 rows but blocked one context_missing-to-classified correction because the parser treated the required fields created by that outcome transition as five independent reasons. Selector v24 treats that valid canonical transition as one coupled outcome change while retaining dimension-level reasons when the outcome is unchanged. This second replay uses the same pinned paid-response corpus, permits no transport, was designed after inspecting consumed-development output, and cannot approve release.

cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort; unchanged from v18, v23, and v24

source_run.prior_replay_result: blocked before candidate write on one coupled outcome transition

selection.classification_authority: the reviewer's complete validated canonical classification
selection.derived_metadata: decision and ordered change_reasons are derived from the canonical primary-versus-review diff
selection.outcome_transition: classified-to-context_missing or context_missing-to-classified is one coupled outcome reason; fields required by that outcome do not add reasons
selection.unchanged_outcome: post types, product labels, sentiment, and nationalism changes retain their own ordered reason categories
selection.evidence: a replacement evidence array must contain at least as many exact valid rows as there are derived reasons; the wire schema does not map individual rows to reasons
selection.repair_scope: one invalid post-brand packet receives only its matching response fragment
selection.failure: unknown reason values, invalid canonical classifications, invalid or insufficient evidence, identity/cardinality errors, or a failed repair leave the post unpublished

decision_rule: Apply the same consumed-development continuation floors frozen for v23. A pass may justify a separately frozen 500-row development run but cannot approve release because both parser corrections were designed after inspecting these responses.
global_stop: Every provider call must resolve from the exact frozen response corpus. The first cache miss stops the replay before transport because request, attempt, token, and dollar caps are all zero.
